title: Canvas hint pills on the image pages adopt the shared one
goal: The small floating hint that names the current gesture on the canvas is redrawn on four image and grading pages, each with its own near-identical copy of the same styling. This points them all at the shared one so the hint stays consistent as it changes.
notes:
VERIFIED IN THE SOURCE (2026-08-24). The page list in the original notes is wrong: it named eight pages / nine rules, and only FOUR pages actually hand-roll the canvas hint pill. REAL ADOPTERS (4 pages, 4 rules), all center-bottom on the artboard, all with a `.X b{color:#fff;font-weight:640}` child rule: - pages/image.html:36 `.cvhint`, bottom:12px, font-size:10px, color rgba(255,255,255,.72), bg rgba(0,0,0,.36), padding 4px 10px, border-radius:7px, NO border, NO z-index, NO pointer-events. - pages/img-bg-remove.html:61 `.cvhint`, bottom:12px, 10.5px, color .86, bg rgba(10,12,20,.5), padding 5px 12px, radius 999px, 1px border rgba(255,255,255,.16), z-index:4, pointer-events:none. - pages/img-masking.html:57 `.cvhint`, byte-identical to img-bg-remove. ONE rule, not the two the notes claimed. - pages/img-grade-wt.html:55 `.g-hint`, bottom:12px, 10px, color .74, bg rgba(0,0,0,.4), padding 4px 10px, radius 7px, z-index:2, no border. Plus a page refinement at line 83: `@container shell (max-width:620px){ #img-grade-wt .g-hint{display:none} }`. NOT ADOPTERS, the other four named pages have no canvas hint pill at all: - img-retouch-wt.html:75 `.fqtag` is a technique tag sitting BELOW the artwork (bottom:-26px, radius 7px, no border) that labels a layer split ("skin split · color + detail"). Different component, different anchor, do not fold it in. - video-audio.html has nothing matching (no hint/badge/pill rule anywhere). - video-compositing.html `#ckHint` is a `

` built into a PROPERTIES panel string at line 525, not on the canvas. - video-transitions.html:28 `.tbadge` is a top-right selection readout with an accent border, showing the selected transition name and duration. Same glass family, different job (selection state, not gesture instruction). MISSED BY THE NOTES: pages/redline.html:99 `.rl-hint` is a fifth hint, but it is stacked top-left under the legend with an accent icon and var(--dim) text, not center-bottom. Folding it in means overriding left/transform as well as top, so it is a judgment call, not a mechanical swap. Worth deciding before this task is revived. THE ACCEPTANCE ITEMS CONTRADICT EACH OTHER for two of the four pages. "Use the shared styling" and "render the same as before" cannot both hold on image.html and img-grade-wt.html: both draw a 7px rounded RECTANGLE with no border, and `.cnv-hint` is a 999px pill WITH a 1px border, at a different opacity and weight. Those two pages will visibly change. img-bg-remove and img-masking are near-identical to the shared rule and will barely move (bottom 12->10, bg .5->.72, color .86->.9, padding 12px->11px, weight inherits->560). Whoever revives this should rewrite acceptance item 2 as "the two pill-shaped hints are unchanged and the two rounded-rect hints become pills" rather than pretending nothing moves. CORRECTED RECIPE: 1. `.cnv-hint` has no `b` rule, and all four pages bold a word inside the hint. Either add `.cnv-hint b{color:#fff;font-weight:640}` to shared/components/canvas.css (and rebuild shared/dist/photonz-ds.css, which carries the same rule at line 433), or keep a one-line scoped `b` refinement per page. Adding it to the shared component is right: every existing adopter (draw, draw-boolean, vector-wt) bolds too. 2. Delete the four local rules, change the four markup class names to `cnv-hint` (image.html:128, img-bg-remove.html:192, img-masking.html:146, img-grade-wt.html:139). 3. Keep exactly two scoped refinements: nothing for image/img-bg-remove/img-masking (bottom:10px is fine on all three; do not re-add bottom:12px just to preserve a 2px difference), and for img-grade-wt keep only the container-query hide, retargeted to `#img-grade-wt .cnv-hint`. 4. The ids `cvhint` (img-bg-remove:455-465, img-masking:516) and `gHint` (img-grade-wt:536,576) are read by page JS to rewrite the text. Keep the ids, only the class changes. 5. Verify: all four pages 200 plus the audit sweep, and eyeball image.html and img-grade-wt.html specifically since those two intentionally change shape.
acceptance: The four pages that actually hand-roll the canvas hint pill (image, img-bg-remove, img-masking, img-grade-wt) use the shared styling instead
The bolded word inside every hint still reads white and heavier, on the shared pages too
img-grade-wt still hides its hint when the window gets narrow
All four pages load without error and pass the automated page sweep
